sources.title: Models | Whisper API Docs
sources.snippet: The Whisper API uses GGML-format model files (.bin) compatible with whisper.cpp. Files live under MODELS_DIR (default models/). The server exposes a fixed registry in code (model_names in app/utils/constant.py): GET /v1/models lists registry entries whose matching .bin file exists on disk. On startup, missing registry models can be downloaded automatically (see app/utils/checks.py).
